_comment: Governance baseline v2 — REMOVE-ONLY per-finding debt ledger, seeded 2026-10-07 after the scheduled-scan false-positive fix (comments, imports and tests no longer scanned; Mantine useMediaQuery/useMatches reclassified MEDIUM per docs/mantine-responsive-design-system.md). Key: "<scan> :: <file> :: <rule pattern>", value: HIGH/CRITICAL occurrence count in that file. A new key or a higher count fails CI; a lower count is stale and fails until `npm run governance:update-baseline` records it. Never add entries: fix the code, or fix the scanner if the finding is false. Replaces the version 1 per-scan counts (HIGH caps: primitives 57, responsive 30, tailwind 10, ssr 0, localization 0).
